title: Untitled (Triptych with Targets)
description: Panoramic collage composed of three white rectangular panels mounted over a dense, chaotic ground of concentric target rings, warplane silhouettes, soccer balls, and photographic fragments. Black ink lines, vertical gold stripes, and layered paper ephemera fill every interval between the panels.
composition: three blank panels over dense layered ground
keywords: perforated white panel over street art ground
